misunderstand.definition: v interpret in the wrong way

misunderstanding.definition:
n putting the wrong interpretation on
n an understanding of something that is not correct
v interpret in the wrong way
misunderstanding.translation:
n. 误会, 误解
[法] 误解, 误会, 不和

misunderstandings.definition:
n. putting the wrong interpretation on
n. an understanding of something that is not correct
v. interpret in the wrong way
misunderstandings.translation: n. 误解( misunderstanding的复数形式 ); 意见不一; 不和; 争执

misunderstands.definition: v interpret in the wrong way
misunderstands.translation: v. 误会, 误解( misunderstand的第三人称单数 )

misusage.translation:
n. 误用, 滥用, 虐待
[法] 误用, 滥用, 苛待

misuse.translation:
n. 误用, 滥用
vt. 误用, 滥用, 虐待

misuse failure.translation: [计] 误操作失效, 误用故障

misused.definition: a. used incorrectly or carelessly or for an improper purpose
misused.translation: v. 使用…不当( misuse的过去式和过去分词 ); 把…派作不正当的用途; 虐待; 滥用

misuser.definition:
n. One who misuses.
n. Unlawful use of a right; use in excess of, or varying
   from, one's right.
misuser.translation:
n. 误用者, 虐待者, 滥用者
[法] 判断职权者, 滥用者, 误用者

misusers.definition:
plural of misuser
n. One who misuses.
n. Unlawful use of a right; use in excess of, or varying
   from, one's right.
misusers.translation:
(misuser 的复数) n. 误用者, 虐待者, 滥用者
[法] 判断职权者, 滥用者, 误用者

misuses.definition:
n improper or excessive use
v apply to a wrong thing or person; apply badly or incorrectly
v change the inherent purpose or function of something
misuses.translation:
n. 用错, 滥用( misuse的名词复数 ); 误用者
v. 使用…不当( misuse的第三人称单数 ); 把…派作不正当的用途; 虐待; 滥用

misusing.definition:
v apply to a wrong thing or person; apply badly or incorrectly
v change the inherent purpose or function of something
misusing.translation: v. 使用…不当( misuse的现在分词 ); 把…派作不正当的用途; 虐待; 滥用
